entries.category_description: Medical equipment, aids and other appliances normally intended to alleviate or treat disability, for the exclusive personal use of the disabled, including the repair of such goods
entries.comment:
Royal Decree N° 20, Table A, cat. XXIII, n° 7 to 8 
The reduced rate only applies to:
- (PICC) peripheral insertion central catheters, introd. surgically + for a prolonged period into the human body for the purpose of adm. intravenous medications (chemo, parenteral nutrition, etc.) and samples frequent blood: 9018 3900
- infusion pumps: 9018 9050
- glucometers, whether/not accompanied by their accessories: 9027 8017

entries.category_description: Pharmaceutical products of a kind normally used for health care, prevention of illness and as treatment for medical and veterinary purposes, including products used for contraception and sanitary protection
entries.comment: For non reimbursed pharmaceutical products (article 278 quater of the general tax code)

entries.category_description: Medical equipment, aids and other appliances normally intended to alleviate or treat disability, for the exclusive personal use of the disabled, including the repair of such goods
entries.comment: Applies to medical equipment, aids and other appliances normally intended to alleviate or treat disability, for the exclusive personal use of the disabled people, prescribed by an act of general application on orthopaedic and other aids.

entries.category_description: Medical equipment, aids and other appliances normally intended to alleviate or treat disability, for the exclusive personal use of the disabled, including the repair of such goods
entries.comment: Pulmonary ventilators for intensive and sub-intensive care; multi-parameter monitor also for transport; infusion pumps for drugs and peristaltic pumps for enteral feeding; endotracheal tubes; helmets for continuous positive pressure ventilation; non-invasive ventilation masks; suction systems; humidifiers; laryngoscopes; vascular access instrumentation; electric vacuum cleaner; monitoring center for intensive care; portable ultrasound scan; electrocardiograph; computerized tomograph.
